stories.title: Samsung Bans Smart TV Apps That Expose Users' Internet Connections
stories.summary: Samsung has reportedly banned smart TV apps that share or expose users' internet connections with third parties, targeting proxyware-style apps that route strangers' traffic through people's home networks. Separately, Samsung's smart monitor has been discounted to $349.99, reportedly its lowest price yet.
stories.whyItMatters: Apps that piggyback on users' home internet connections raise real privacy and security concerns, and a platform-level ban from a major TV maker could pressure other device makers to follow suit.
